neighbours.label: ' used' in a frequency compound ('most used', 'frequently used', 'often used', 'commonly used' + noun: the things one reaches for most); weaker on 'functions of several/multiple' items combined in one; 'used' as a plain past-tense verb stays quiet
fire: The dock at the bottom of the screen holds my most used programs.
Pin your frequently used folders to the sidebar so they are one click away.
The cheat sheet lists the most commonly used formulas for the exam.
She keeps her often used spices on a rack right beside the stove.
The remote has four buttons you can assign to your most used channels.
A glossary of frequently used terms appears at the back of the manual.
Store the commonly used wrenches on the top tray of the toolbox.
The app remembers your most used emoji and shows them first.
quiet: The dock at the bottom of the screen broke when I dropped the laptop.
She used the sidebar once and then closed it for good.
The cheat sheet was confiscated before the exam even started.
She bought her spices at a market right beside the station.
The remote has four buttons, and my brother used all of them at once.
A glossary of medical terms appears at the back of the manual.

notes: Card: 'most used apps', 'often used parts', 常用的, also ' multiple', 'sudo' in an alias, ' creation'. Probes: 'most used commands' 1.16, 'frequently used phrases' 0.64, 'functions of several devices' 0.36; 'I used a hammer' 0.01. The label covers only the frequency-compound part of the card.
